text_block_list.text: The day of the Takarazuka Kinen.

The venue was completely abuzz with 
anticipation for the one-on-one showdown 
between the "Empress" Air Groove and the 
"Otherworldly Escape Artist" Silence 
Suzuka.

Amidst all this... the two exchange few 
words, quietly heading toward the battle 
ahead.
